style.styleTitle: Personalised Metallic Engagement Silhouette Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: The glass bauble surrounds the silhouette of a couple made from mirror acrylic standing in front of an engraved, frosted acrylic moon. Showing a proposal scene, this is perfect to gift a newly engaged couple at Christmas. The characters featured can be selected from the drop-down to include same-sex couples, and the frosted archway can be personalised with the couple's names and two lines of text. Available in either gold or silver mirror acrylic to add a personal touch to your Christmas tree. Baubles measure 10cm and are finished with velvet ribbon in your choice of colour. Dimensions(mm): Height: 110 Width: 110 Depth: 110.
